# Emily Russell, REALTOR®

> Licensed San Antonio REALTOR® with Fathom Realty, helping buyers, sellers, and relocating families across Alamo Ranch, Stone Oak, Helotes, Boerne, and the Texas Hill Country.

Emily Russell specializes in buyer representation, new-construction guidance, home valuations, and relocation assistance throughout the Greater San Antonio area. The site offers neighborhood guides, market insights, a rent-vs-buy calculator, and direct contact for prospective clients.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About Emily, services, featured San Antonio neighborhoods, recent sales, new-construction partners, reviews, and contact form.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](/rent-vs-buy): Interactive tool to compare the long-term cost of renting versus buying a San Antonio home.
- [New Construction Communities](/communities): Index of the San Antonio new-construction communities covered on this site, with verified community facts and links to each guide.
- [Redbird Ranch School Zones](/redbird-ranch-school-district): How Redbird Ranch (78253) is split between Northside ISD and Medina Valley ISD, and how to verify the district for a specific lot.
- [PCS to Lackland: Redbird Ranch](/pcs-lackland-redbird-ranch): Guide for military families with orders to JBSA-Lackland buying new construction at Redbird Ranch — BAH math, VA loan rules, and builder registration pitfalls.
- [TREC Disclosures](/trec): Texas Real Estate Commission Information About Brokerage Services (IABS) and Consumer Protection Notice.
- [Fair Housing](/fair-housing): Equal Housing Opportunity commitment and HUD fair-housing resources.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How personal information collected through lead forms is used and protected.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Terms governing use of alamocitydesigns.com.
